original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: For one PR717 P104 decoder pivot, append a Gaussian-integer isotropic null pair and apply one compensated 3-column shear; exhaust every distinct ordered z,w supported on at most two standard coordinates with Gaussian-unit entries, then price exact support-pair ranks and the per-call moment profile.
scope_change_reason: The broad card asks for a changed helper inventory. This experiment changes the exact decoder term count from eight to ten by adding a cancelling complex null pair, rather than reassigning the original eight term bases or moving nested endpoints in the selected word. The support domain is bounded and independently exact. Its optimistic profile clears the local 5% screen only if the existing centre charge stays fixed; the copied-rank census decides whether any candidate merits physical compilation.
bottleneck_link: The P104 eight-term copy bill is 56. A lower-cost ten-term factorization could change the local recursive profile, but this compensated family has minimum block bill 21 replacing one rank-7 term, so its total copied rank is at least 70 before physical overhead.
stop_rule: Enumerate all 480 Gaussian-unit vectors with support at most two of the eight standard coordinates, all ordered distinct z,w pairs, and all eight decoder pivots. Stop at this domain; do not infer bounds for wider supports, other coefficients, multiple pivots, or arbitrary ten-term decoders.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json: 1,839,360 pivot/pair candidates; exact block-rank minimum 21 versus baseline 7; total copied-rank minimum 70 versus baseline 56; exact 104-by-104 input and transformed identities; wrong-sign control fails; the per-call screen includes six rank-one setup/cleanup charges. The candidate profile still clears the inherited P104 five-percent relaxation, but the unmodified P104 decoder already clears it and every compensated block strictly increases copied rank.
author: OpenAI Codex
ai_assistance: Substantial: OpenAI Codex derived the null-pair shear, implemented the exact E8 support/rank census, constructed the budget screen and wrote the package. No independent human review is claimed.

open_questions.question: Can three-coordinate supports or non-unit Gaussian coefficients make this compensated null-pair shear reduce the copied-rank bill?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Only a lower-cost block could alter the complex helper inventory enough to justify physical compilation.
open_questions.first_step: Derive a support-rank lower bound or define one bounded three-coordinate coefficient alphabet, calculate its complete charged ceiling first, then claim and enumerate that scope.
open_questions.blocked_by: This package exhausts only the two-coordinate Gaussian-unit domain and provides no general support inequality.
